subcategory_text: Software is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk
informative_references: CRI Profile v2.0: PR.PS-02, PR.PS-02.01, PR.PS-02.02, PR.PS-02.03
implementation_examples: Perform routine and emergency patching within the timeframes specified in the vulnerability management plan
Update container images, and deploy new container instances to replace rather than update existing instances
Replace end-of-life software and service versions with supported, maintained versions
Uninstall and remove unauthorized software and services that pose undue risks
Uninstall and remove any unnecessary software components (e.g., operating system utilities) that attackers might misuse
Define and implement plans for software and service end-of-life maintenance support and obsolescence
assessment_objectives: Determine whether software is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk.
Determine whether activities are conducted to perform routine and emergency patching within the timeframes specified in the vulnerability management plan.
Determine whether activities are conducted to update container images, and deploy new container instances to replace rather than update existing instances.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
